info.title: Symplast Insurance Public API
info.description: Authenticated, read-only public surface for a patient's insurance claims, with their charge lines, and for the practice's insurance companies (payers).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `insurance.claims.read`

Returns one patient's insurance claims, cursor-paged, each with all of its charge lines. `patientId` is
required. Claims in every status are included, deleted ones with `status` `deleted`. Ordered by `id`
ascending. Follow `next` to page further.

A patient the signed-in user may not access gives an empty page, exactly like a patient with no claims. This
is not a change feed: there is no `updatedSince`, and an unknown query parameter is ignored. Every page that
returns a claim is recorded in the practice's patient access log.

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description: The patient whose claims are listed (the patient id from the public patients API). Required. A patient the signed-in user may not access, or one with no claims, gives an empty page rather than an error.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, taken from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Pass it back unchanged with the same filters; omit it for the first page. The `next` link already carries it.

200.description: A page of the patient's claims, with their charge lines. Empty when the patient has no claims the signed-in user may see.

400.description: A query value is missing, malformed or out of range (code `invalid-query-parameter`, with every rejected parameter in `errors`), the cursor is malformed or tampered (code `invalid-cursor`), or the cursor was issued for a different `patientId` (code `cursor-filter-mismatch`).

401.description: The request carries no valid gateway token. That is an RFC 9457 problem with code `unauthenticated`.

403.description:
The request has no signed-in user the API can resolve, or the user does not exist in the caller's tenant. That is an RFC 9457 problem with code `user-context-required`.

A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `insurance.claims.read`

Returns one claim with all of its charge lines, in the same shape as the claims list. A claim of a patient the
signed-in user may not access is a 404, exactly like a claim that does not exist. A returned claim is
recorded in the practice's patient access log.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The claim id, as returned in `id` by the claims list.

200.description: The claim, with its charge lines.

401.description: The request carries no valid gateway token. That is an RFC 9457 problem with code `unauthenticated`.

403.description:
The request has no signed-in user the API can resolve, or the user does not exist in the caller's tenant. That is an RFC 9457 problem with code `user-context-required`.

A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

404.description: No claim with this id exists in the practice, or its patient is one the signed-in user may not access (code `not-found`).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `insurance.payers.read`

Returns the practice's insurance companies (payers), cursor-paged, deleted ones included with `isDeleted`
true, so every `payerId` on a claim or a patient insurance policy resolves. Ordered by `id` ascending. Follow
`next` to page further. Needs no signed-in user.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, taken from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Pass it back unchanged with the same filters; omit it for the first page. The `next` link already carries it.

200.description: A page of the practice's payers.

400.description: A query value is malformed or out of range (code `invalid-query-parameter`, with every rejected parameter in `errors`), or the cursor is malformed or tampered (code `invalid-cursor`).

401.description: The request carries no valid gateway token. That is an RFC 9457 problem with code `unauthenticated`.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `insurance.payers.read`

Returns one of the practice's insurance companies, including a deleted one. Use it to resolve a `payerId`
from a claim or a patient insurance policy. Needs no signed-in user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The payer id, as claims return it in `payerId` and `secondaryPayerId`.

401.description: The request carries no valid gateway token. That is an RFC 9457 problem with code `unauthenticated`.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

404.description: No payer with this id exists in the practice (code `not-found`).

data.description: The items in this page, in feed order. Empty when there are none.

pageSize.description: The page size used for this page: the requested `pageSize`, or the default.

count.description: The number of items in `data`; never more than `pageSize`.

hasMore.description: Whether another page follows. Keep paging while this is true.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, to pass as `cursor`. Null when `hasMore` is false.

next.description: Relative URL of the next page, ready to request. Null when `hasMore` is false.

PagedResponsePublicClaim.description: One page of `PublicClaim` items. Keep following `next` (or pass `nextCursor` as `cursor`) while `hasMore` is true.

pageSize.description: The page size used for this page: the requested `pageSize`, or the default.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: URI reference identifying this occurrence of the problem.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details describing an error response.

PublicChargeStatus.description: Whether a charge line is active, closed or deleted. `active`: open. `closed`: closed. `deleted`: removed from the claim by the practice. New values may be added: tolerate unknown values.

id.description: The claim id, unique within the practice.

claimNumber.description: The practice's claim number, or `null` when none was recorded.

patientId.description: The patient the claim is for (the same id as in the public patients API).

status.description: Where the claim is in its life cycle.

type.description: Whether this is a primary claim or a secondary claim created from one.

relatedClaimId.description: For a secondary claim, the primary claim it was created from; otherwise `null`.

dateOfService.description: The date of service, as a calendar date (no time zone), or `null` when none was recorded.

createdAt.description: When the claim was created, as a UTC instant.

submittedAt.description: When the claim was submitted to the payer, as a UTC instant, or `null` when it has not been submitted.

closedAt.description: When the claim was closed, as a UTC instant, or `null` when it has not been closed.

payerId.description: The primary payer. Resolve it with `GET /v1/insurance/payers/{id}`; patient insurance policies use the same id.

policyNumber.description: The patient's policy number with the primary payer, or `null` when none was recorded.

secondaryPayerId.description: The secondary payer, or `null` when the claim has none.

secondaryPolicyNumber.description: The patient's policy number with the secondary payer, or `null` when none was recorded.

appointmentId.description: The appointment the claim bills, or `null` when it is not linked to one.

invoiceId.description: The invoice the claim bills, or `null` when it is not linked to one.

locationId.description: The practice location that bills the claim.

serviceLocationId.description: The practice location where the service was provided.

providerId.description: The rendering provider's user id, or `null` when none was recorded.

oneOf.description: The referring provider, or `null` when the claim has none.

balanceDue.description: What is still owed on the claim: `insuranceBalanceDue` plus `patientBalanceDue`.

insuranceBalanceDue.description: What the payers still owe on the claim.

patientBalanceDue.description: What the patient still owes on the claim.

charges.description: The claim's charge lines, ordered by `order`, then `id`. Deleted lines are included.

PublicClaim.description:
An insurance claim: what the practice billed a payer for one patient, its status, and what is still owed. This is the
entire externally exposed field set: it excludes claim revisions and every EDI, X12 or HCFA payload, free-text notes,
the prior-authorization code, condition-related-to and accident indicators, user ids, the patient's name and date of
birth, cases, authorizations, remittances and individual payments.

order.description: The line's position on the claim, starting at 1.

status.description: Whether the line is active, closed or deleted.

procedure.description: The procedure (CPT or HCPCS) code billed.

modifiers.description: The procedure modifiers, in the order they were added. Empty when there are none.

diagnoses.description: The diagnosis (ICD) codes the line points to, in the line's diagnosis order. Empty when there are none.

units.description: The number of units billed, or `null` when none was recorded.

amount.description: The billed amount, or a percentage when `isPercentage` is true.

isPercentage.description: Whether `amount` is a percentage rather than a money amount.

balanceDue.description: What is still owed on the line: `insuranceBalanceDue` plus `patientBalanceDue`.

insuranceBalanceDue.description: What the payer still owes on the line.

patientBalanceDue.description: What the patient still owes on the line.

invoiceItemId.description: The invoice item the line bills, or `null` when it is not linked to one.

oneOf.description: The drug (NDC) billed on the line, or `null` when the line bills no drug.

PublicClaimCharge.description: A charge line on a claim: one billed procedure with its codes, units, amounts and balances.

PublicClaimStatus.description: Where a claim is in its life cycle. `draft`: being prepared. `active`: open. `queued`: waiting to be sent. `transmitted`: sent to the clearinghouse. `transmitFailed`: sending failed. `exported`: exported for submission outside Symplast. `submitted`: submitted to the payer. `approved`: approved by the payer. `rejected`: rejected by the clearinghouse or payer. `denied`: denied by the payer. `paidPatientDue`: paid by the payer, with a balance left for the patient. `paymentReceivedNeedsReview`: a payment arrived and needs review. `paymentReceivedAppealing`: a payment arrived and is being appealed. `paymentReceivedReadyForSecondary`: a payment arrived and the balance is ready to bill to the secondary payer. `paymentReceivedSecondaryCreated`: a payment arrived and a secondary claim was created. `closedSecondaryCreated`: closed after a secondary claim was created. `closed`: closed. `deleted`: deleted by the practice. New values may be added: treat an unknown value as an open claim in an unrecognised state rather than failing.

PublicClaimType.description: Whether a claim bills the primary payer or the secondary payer. `primary`: a claim to the patient's primary payer. `secondary`: a claim to the secondary payer, created from a primary claim (see `relatedClaimId`). New values may be added: tolerate unknown values.

code.description: The code, or `null` when the catalog entry has none.

description.description: The catalog's description of the code, or `null` when it has none.

PublicCodeReference.description: A billing code from the practice's code catalog, with its description.

ndcCode.description: The National Drug Code, or `null` when none was recorded.

unitOfMeasure.description: The unit `quantity` is measured in (such as `ML` or `UN`), or `null` when none was recorded.

PublicDrug.description: A drug billed on a charge line, identified by its National Drug Code.

id.description: The payer id, unique within the practice. The value claims and patient insurance policies use as `payerId`.

name.description: The company name, or `null` when none was recorded.

ediPayerId.description: The payer id used on electronic claims (assigned by the clearinghouse), or `null` when none was recorded.

phone.description: The phone number as the practice entered it, or `null`.

fax.description: The fax number as the practice entered it, or `null`.

address.description: The payer's claims mailing address. Every field is present; any the practice did not enter is `null`.

isDeleted.description: Whether the practice has deleted the payer.

PublicPayer.description:
One of the practice's insurance companies (payers). Claims (`payerId`, `secondaryPayerId`) and patient insurance
policies refer to payers by `id`. Deleted payers remain visible with `isDeleted` true, so every reference resolves.

id.description: The referring provider id, unique within the practice.

PublicReferringProvider.description: The provider who referred the patient for the billed service.

Bearer.description: Bearer access token. Send it as the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

tags.name: Claims
tags.description: Insurance claims: what the practice billed a payer for a patient, with each charge line's procedure, diagnosis and drug codes, its status, and what is still owed. List a patient's claims, or read one by id.

tags.name: Payers
tags.description: The practice's insurance companies. Resolve the `payerId` of a claim or a patient insurance policy here, or list them all.
